entries.title: Genesis 34:2
segments: Next to the fear and love of God, the guardianship of parents is the great safeguard of children.

entries.title: Genesis 34:5
segments: In this life, trials often succeed trials like the waves of the sea; the passing away of some being quickly followed by the coming of others.

entries.title: Genesis 34:13
segments:
Deceitfully; pretending one thing and meaning another. 
 
  And said; to justify the crime they were plotting. 
 
The deceitfulness of parents is often dreadfully punished by the deceitfulness of their children.

entries.title: Genesis 34:14
segments: We cannot; this shows the manner in which the word cannot is often used in the Bible, referring, not to power, but choice.

entries.title: Genesis 34:16
segments: Then will we give; this was false, and designed to deceive Hamor and Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 34:19
segments: Deferred not; did not hesitate to do what they proposed.

entries.title: Genesis 34:24
segments: Pecuniary considerations have great influence with men, and they will readily submit to much self-denial for the sake of making money.

entries.title: Genesis 34:29
segments:
The house; the houses of the Shechemites. 
 
Deceit, hypocrisy, and a profane use of divine ordinances, blind the mind, harden the heart, sear the conscience, and prepare the way for the most abominable crimes.
